Bridge WebSocket signature failures (TAC log lines)
A bridge has run off the preferred model (us.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5) for 15 minutes (ActiveRank above 0)
A model entry is unavailable (model_unavailable on the bridge): the bridge has moved to the next entry; the log line names the entry and the error code

Properties.Description: OwlBank relay WebSocket host (fargate); the front door builds wss://<host>/ws
Properties.Name: /owlbank/prod/bridge/relay
OwlBank/Trace a call by call SID

Parameters.Description: The call SID to trace, in double quotes, e.g. "CA0123..." (32 hex after CA)
Parameters.Name: call_sid

Properties.QueryString:
fields @timestamp, @log, component, event, level, op, outcome, duration_ms, @message
| filter call_sid = {{call_sid}}
| sort @timestamp asc
| limit 10000

Properties.Name: OwlBank/Errors by component
Properties.QueryString:
fields @timestamp, component, event, level, outcome
| filter level in ["ERROR", "WARNING", "WARN", "CRITICAL"] or outcome = "error"
| stats count(*) as occurrences by component, event
| sort occurrences desc

Properties.Name: OwlBank/Slowest invocations and dependency calls
Properties.QueryString:
fields @timestamp, component, event, op, dependency, operation, duration_ms, call_sid
| filter event in ["invocation_end", "dependency_call"]
| filter ispresent(duration_ms)
| sort duration_ms desc
| limit 50

Properties.Name: OwlBank/Auth failures
Properties.QueryString:
fields @timestamp, event, component, reason
| filter event in ["twilio_auth_failed", "verification_failed", "rate_limited", "verification_risk", "otp_sent_untrusted_ani"]
| stats count(*) as occurrences by bin(5m), event, component, reason
| sort occurrences desc

Properties.Name: OwlBank/Escalations by reason
Properties.QueryString:
fields @timestamp, reason, source
| filter event = "escalation"
| stats count(*) as escalations by reason, source
| sort escalations desc
